definitions.explanation: A girl or woman who has been legally adopted into a family. The female counterpart of {養子|ようし} (adopted child, traditionally male).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{養女|ようじょ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{迎|むか}えられた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: She was taken in as an adopted daughter.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもがいなかった⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{養女|ようじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The childless couple adopted a daughter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{家業|かぎょう}→家業：12353_kagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}がせる→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{養女|ようじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{婿養子|むこようし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Historically, families would sometimes adopt a daughter and bring in her husband as an adopted son-in-law to continue the family business.

notes:
The formal term for an adopted daughter, as opposed to ⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧ which can mean adopted child in general but traditionally refers to an adopted son.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {養女|ようじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to adopt a daughter
- {養女|ようじょ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to raise as an adopted daughter
- {養女|ようじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to give up (a daughter) for adoption

CULTURAL NOTE:
In traditional Japan, adoption was often strategic — to secure an heir for a family line. Adopting a daughter ({養女|ようじょ}) and then bringing in a son-in-law ({婿養子|むこようし}) was one way to continue a family name.

- ⟦{養親|ようしん}→養親：16814_youshin⟧: adoptive parent
